name: Retrain
description: Spend time doing activities to retrain any of your chosen abilities, features, or if it makes sense in the story, possibly even your subclass.

name: Gather Information
description: Meet NPCs, pick up news, or collect rumors and job leads.

name: Personal Goals
description: Pursue goals from your back-story or other smaller quests you've chosen.

name: Buy & Sell
description: Get new equipment, and sell treasures you've collected while out adventuring.

name: Perform
description: Play music, tell stories, compete, or perform in public to earn gold or fame.

name: Craft
description: Create weapons, armor, or simple items using materials you've acquired.

name: Socialize
description: Build alliances, make new friends, or make new enemies.

name: Invest
description: Use your gold to invest in businesses or trade ventures for future profit.

name: Mentor
description: Teach a skill or ability to another character or NPC.

name: Research
description: Investigate a mystery, study ancient texts, or uncover hidden knowledge.

name: Serve
description: Aid a patron or a deity in exchange for a favor, or perform charity for townsfolk.

name: Build
description: Establish a home base, start a business, craft siege weapons, or build anything else you can imagine (GM and setting-permitting, of course).
